text: Ask your agent for a picture. It writes you a prompt.
say: [calm] Ask your agent for a picture. [pause] It writes you a prompt.

text: Ask it to listen to a recording. It asks you for the transcript.
say: Ask it to listen to a recording... It asks you for the transcript.

text: Ask if its GPU code works. It says it should.
say: Ask if its GPU code works. [pause] [softly] It says it should.

text: You could give it a GPU yourself.
say: You could give it a GPU yourself.

text: Open an account. Paste a cloud key into the chat. Install CUDA. Keep an eye on the box.
say: [quickly] Open an account. Paste a cloud key into the chat. Install CUDA. Keep an eye on the box.

text: Then nobody watches it, and the bill keeps running. One developer expected a hundred dollars. The bill was a thousand.
say: [sighs] Then nobody watches it... and the bill keeps running. One developer expected a hundred dollars. [pause] The bill was a thousand.

text: And an agent holding a cloud key with no limits? Someone called that “terrifying.”
say: And an agent holding a cloud key, with no limits? [pause] Someone called that... terrifying.

text: GPU for Agents gives it the power, with the controls built in.
say: [determined] GPU for Agents gives it the power... with the controls built in.

text: Paste one line. The agent rents its own GPU and sets it up in minutes.
say: Paste one line. The agent rents its own GPU, and sets it up in minutes.

text: Now it makes images and voices.
say: [excited] Now it makes images! And voices.

text: It transcribes audio on its own GPU, without a third-party API.
say: It transcribes audio on its own GPU, without a third-party API.

text: It runs open models, under your rules, and tests its own GPU code on real hardware.
say: It runs open models, under your rules... and tests its own GPU code on real hardware.

text: Everything sits behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that its tools already call.
say: Everything sits behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that its tools already call.

text: You set the budget. The agent sees the price before it rents, and the machine shuts itself down at your cap.
say: [calm] You set the budget. The agent sees the price before it rents... and the machine shuts itself down at your cap.

text: Every step goes into an event log, so you can audit what it did and what it cost.
say: Every step goes into an event log, so you can audit what it did, and what it cost.

text: A watchdog runs inside the machine. When the work stops, the GPU stops.
say: A watchdog runs inside the machine. When the work stops... the GPU stops.

text: Even if you closed the chat.
say: [softly] Even if you closed the chat.

text: New powers for your agent. And you keep the controls.
say: [warmly] New powers for your agent. [pause] And you keep the controls.
